summary: A six-lane tracker and digital drum machine firmware: five synth channels and one drum channel, edited on a tracker grid with the FM-1's own controls. Its USB multitrack and user sample features are marked experimental.
features: Five synth lanes and a drum lane with up to three hits per step
48 patterns of 1 to 16 steps; 64-position song chains per channel
12 oscillator types, 8 shared synth voices, 14 built-in drum sounds
Mixer, mute and solo, punch-in effects, snapshots and mute groups
Six separate mono channels or stereo master recorded over USB audio
13 shared user sample slots, about 10 to 20 seconds in total

headings: global user samples & storage v2 experimental
migrating an existing fm1 to storage v2
usb-c audio capture: stereo or six-track mode experimental
